steps.command:
set -eu
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 update -qq
apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 install -y -qq ca-certificates curl jq openssl ufw unzip >/dev/null

sed -i '/# BEGIN INFRASET CLUSTER HOSTS/,/# END INFRASET CLUSTER HOSTS/d' /etc/hosts
printf '# BEGIN INFRASET CLUSTER HOSTS\n%s\n# END INFRASET CLUSTER HOSTS\n' "$CLUSTER_HOSTS" >> /etc/hosts
getent group loki >/dev/null 2>&1 || groupadd --system loki
id loki >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd --system --gid loki --home-dir /var/lib/loki --shell /usr/sbin/nologin loki
install -d -o root -g loki -m 0750 /etc/loki
install -d -o loki -g loki -m 0750 /var/lib/loki /var/lib/loki/chunks /var/lib/loki/rules
